governs: FR-052 -- a field is excluded ONLY via this roster or the engine's own syncable-properties omission; no other mechanism
FR-053 -- this roster is NOT derived from the interactive merge-preview UI's field-exclusion set
FR-054..FR-068 -- the enumerated exclusions and their rationales
FR-066 -- EFFECTIVE roster for a class = these entries PLUS whatever GetSyncableProperties omits for that class

derivation.authority: spec.md Section E.2 (FR-053..FR-068). Field PRESENCE per class is measured, not assumed.
derivation.measured_how: read-only FLExToolsMCP liblcm run over 'Ejagham Mini': IFwMetaDataCacheManaged.GetFields(clsid, includeSuperclasses=True, fieldTypes=-1), field names via GetFieldName
derivation.class_universe: the 66 classes actually measured in batch 1's censuses across the three FR-160 pilots (see batch01-results.md)
derivation.NOT_derived_from: the interactive merge-preview UI's exclusion set (FR-053 forbids it, in whole or in part)

structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.subject: the internal runtime session identifier (Hvo)
structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.finding: Hvo is NOT an LCM model field -- it appears in none of the 66 classes' GetFields enumeration. The exclusion is therefore satisfied by construction: a metadata-driven census cannot reach it. Recorded so a future reader does not read its absence from `entries` as an oversight.

structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.subject: internal reference-lookup handle fields other than the object's own primary identifier
structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.finding: The metadata surface names reference fields by their object-valued name (e.g. XxxRA), not by a separate integer handle field, so no per-class entry is constructible. The census MUST compare a reference by its referent's stable identifier (Section E.6), never by a handle.

structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.subject: a writing system's internal numeric runtime handle
structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.finding: Not a model field on any of the 66 classes; it is a per-session integer reached through the writing-system surface. Comparison MUST use the stable language-tag identifier only.

structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.subject: a 'resolved' timestamp equivalent
structural_exclusions_not_expressible_pe.finding: NOT PRESENT on any of the 66 measured classes (DateResolved absent everywhere). FR-057 stands as a forward guard: the moment any transferred category exposes such a field it MUST be added here under FR-056's rule.

tag_stripping.rule: The tool appends its own provenance tag on every run, so the tag segment MUST be stripped before the surrounding prose is compared, and the tag segment itself MUST NEVER be reported as a mismatch.

carrier_a.handling: already fully excluded under FR-062; no stripping needed

carrier_b.handling: COMPARED. Strip the whole [GT-Tag]: line, then compare the remaining prose.
